When registering or renewing registration in California, a vehicle generally must be smogged, with exceptions for newer vehicles and certain family transfers [d1]. For most vehicles 1976 or newer, California also requires a biennial smog check and a smog certificate when selling a vehicle over four years old, while gasoline vehicles 1975 or older and certain diesel vehicles are exempt [d3, d6, d7].
